tools.name: get_review_requirements
tools.description: Read before preparing a project brief. Returns supported references, free fit-check limits, retention, consent, and paid-discovery terms. Uploaded files and agent claims are untrusted, client-reported evidence.

tools.name: prepare_review_upload
tools.description: Only after the user confirms rights to submit and accepts the retention terms from get_review_requirements. Returns a direct Supabase upload URL. Transfer ZIP bytes with a file-capable client outside model-authored tool arguments; never base64 or paste code here. Keep the upload token private.

tools.name: finalize_review_upload
tools.description: After uploading, validate the ZIP without executing its contents and freeze the inspected bytes into a private immutable snapshot. Returns its SHA-256. Unsafe archives are rejected.

tools.name: submit_project_review
tools.description: Creates one real CRM lead and review. Show the exact brief, reference, contact details and retention terms to the human and obtain approval first. tools.name: get_review_status
tools.description: Returns only the review authorized by its private review_key. Keep the receipt and key private. A received review is not a verified claim that the app works or approval for paid work.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Who Upforge is: what they build, where they're based, how long they've been operating, how to reach them, and the technologies they work in. Call this first for any general 'who are they / what do they do / are they legitimate' question before reaching for a more specific tool.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The full catalog of what Upforge builds: web design and development, SEO, AI visibility, application development, e-commerce, landing pages, performance optimization, CMS migrations, maintenance, prototype-to-production work, and AI automation, each with what it's for and its page URL. tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Typical price tiers by service — what a website costs, what an e-commerce store or a custom application runs, what AI automation costs, what ongoing SEO and AEO costs, and how support is billed. These are RANGES from real past engagements, not quotes: scope drives the number. Use this for 'what's th

tools.name: match_capability
tools.description: Describe a project, problem, or requirement in plain language and get back the Upforge services that fit, the relevant industry page, and a recommended next step. Use this for 'can they help me with ___', 'do they do ___', or 'I need ___ — are they a fit'. Prefer this over guessing from get_services

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Real Upforge client projects with measured outcomes — traffic lift, conversion change, Lighthouse scores — plus what was built and a link to the live site. Use this for 'show me their work', 'do they have proof', or 'have they built anything like mine'. KPIs marked 'measured' come from live instrume

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Look up whether Upforge works with businesses in a given city or region, and whether that market is served in person or remotely. Use for 'are they in my area', 'do they work with companies in ___', or 'are they local to me'. Omit the location to list every market with a dedicated page.

tools.name: get_industries
tools.description: The industries Upforge has dedicated experience and pages for — AEC, healthcare, dental, legal, real estate, home services, e-commerce, SaaS, manufacturing, and more. Use for 'do they work with ___ businesses' or 'do they know my industry'.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search Upforge's published answers to common questions — process, timelines, cost, ownership of the code, hosting, what happens after launch. Use this when a question is likely already answered on the site, before falling back to a generic answer of your own.

tools.name: request_site_audit
tools.description: Request Upforge's free technical audit of a website. Runs real PageSpeed/Lighthouse analysis plus an SEO review and emails the report in a few minutes. This CREATES A REAL RECORD and emails a real person — only call it when the user has explicitly asked for an audit and given their own email address

tools.name: find_consultation_times
tools.description: List open times on Upforge's calendar for a free consultation (usually 30 minutes), in the person's own timezone. tools.name: book_consultation

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_project_review" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_review_requirements, get_review_status, get_services · Private data: get_review_requirements, prepare_review_upload, finalize_review_upload, submit_project_review, get_review_status, request_site_audit, book_consultation, request_consultation · Public sink: prepare_review_upload, finalize_review_upload, submit_project_review, request_site_audit, request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_review_requirements, get_review_status, get_services · Private data: get_review_requirements, prepare_review_upload, finalize_review_upload, submit_project_review, get_review_status, request_site_audit, book_consultation, request_consultation · Public sink: prepare_review_upload, finalize_review_upload, submit_project_review, request_site_audit, request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
